## Checklist

A first PR that doesn't reference an issue is closed automatically; see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Ozark-Connect/NetworkOptimizer/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

- [ ] The approach was agreed in the linked issue
- [ ] This PR makes one change
- [ ] It targets `dev` (fix for a released version) or the active `release/X.Y` branch (feature), not `main`
- [ ] It is rebased on the latest target branch
- [ ] `dotnet build` has zero warnings, and tests for the change pass
- [ ] No unrequested UI, styling, or copy changes
- [ ] No new dependencies, project references, or InfluxDB measurements without agreement in the issue
